import paramiko

# Try with experimental-require-module flag

time.sleep(5)

print(stdout.read().decode())
# Check log
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /tmp/server.log")
print("\n=== Server Log ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
